plants.name: Lavandula angustifolia
plants.description: Silvery-green mounds send up slender spikes of tiny, fragrant purple flowers. On warm days the blooms hum with bees and scent the air with a clean, herbal sweetness. In Provence, whole hillsides ripple in violet.
plants.bloomingSeason: June to August, so mid-June is the start of the main flowering season
plants.location: Provence, southern France, on sunny limestone hillsides and in cultivated fields
plants.funFact: Lavender's name probably comes from the Latin 'lavare', meaning 'to wash'. Romans scented their baths with it.

plants.name: Hydrangea macrophylla
plants.description: Big, rounded clusters of flowers weigh down the branches of this classic garden shrub. Some look like pom-poms and others like lacecaps. The color shifts from plant to plant, and the soil does much of the work.
plants.bloomingSeason: Late May in warmer zones to mid-July in colder ones, with a peak from June to August
plants.location: Gardens across much of the United States and temperate regions of the Northern Hemisphere
plants.funFact: Soil chemistry changes the color. Acidic soil lets the plant take up aluminum, which turns the flowers blue. Alkaline soil keeps them pink.
